'baseline' = integrate-head behaviour: every T1..T9 flag off + T3/T4 kill switches (legacy kernels, serial capture ledger, inflight 4, default chunk words). 'fullstack' = every opt flag on + T6 chunk knobs 2^28 words. Only the flags differ; the fixed arena means the runner's fullstack-only physical canary cannot resize the arena. Why v1: on this image (admission v2 exports present, unlike frozen a25) runtime v2 fails the flags-OFF warm request (NativePostGlobalDrainUnavailable, ab4 06:38Z); the canonical baseline env (auto arena) cannot carry the canary (CudaAllocationFailed, ab5 06:42Z).
